title: Security Findings
description: What the agent writes to /output/findings.json. The server fills the Report template with it: the agent never writes report.md. Only `report.summary` and the Finding fields shared by every profile are required, but every field below has a place in the Report and shows as 'Not provided' when missing.

summary.description: Executive summary for a non-specialist reader, 3 to 6 sentences: what the application is, the overall security posture, the most serious problems and what to fix first.

description.description: What the reviewed codebase is and does.

entryPoints.description: Attack surface: routes, CLIs, jobs, consumers, each with whether it needs authentication, e.g. 'GET /notes (authenticated)'.

excluded.description: Paths not reviewed, and why (e.g. the caller's instructions, vendored code).

notes.description: Outcome of the dependency audit, in a few sentences.

strengths.description: Security controls done well, one sentence each (e.g. parameterised queries in the data layer).

recommendations.description: Strategic next steps beyond the single Findings, most important first.

title.description: Short, specific: the flaw and where, e.g. 'SQL injection in GET /notes'.

description.description: The flaw and how an attacker reaches it: source, path through the code, sink.

file.description: Path relative to the workspace root

line.description: First line of the vulnerable code

endLine.description: Last line of the vulnerable code, when it spans several

otherLocations.description: Other places with the same root cause.

cwe.description: The most specific CWE, e.g. CWE-89

owasp.description: OWASP Top 10 2021 category, e.g. A03:2021 Injection

attackScenario.description: A concrete exploit: the request or input an attacker sends and what happens.

impact.description: What the attacker gains: data, privileges, availability.

recommendation.description: The fix, specific to this code; a short code example when it helps.

references.description: URLs of relevant standards or advisories.
